objective: Validación REAL controlada posterior a R12+R13: reparar exclusivamente el detalle ISCAM de CIENFUEGOS para 2026-10-13 y certificar conciliación exacta contra Runtime V2. No tocar encabezado, otras fechas, otras unidades ni Producción.

queries.name: cienfuegos_20261013_post_real
queries.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,4))) ventas,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-13'), d AS (SELECT SUM(x.venta) ventas,COUNT(*) tickets,SUM(x.pax) pax FROM (SELECT numero_ticket,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(18,4))) venta,MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-13' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY numero_ticket) x) SELECT r.ventas AS runtime_ventas,d.ventas AS detalle_ventas,r.tickets AS runtime_tickets,d.tickets AS detalle_tickets,r.pax AS runtime_pax,d.pax AS detalle_pax,CAST(r.ventas-ISNULL(d.ventas,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS delta_venta,r.tickets-ISNULL(d.tickets,0) AS delta_tickets,r.pax-ISNULL(d.pax,0) AS delta_pax FROM r CROSS JOIN d
